recognize_zh: 這張合併圖呈現 NK/T 細胞淋巴瘤的不同臨床型態：硬顎壞死性潰瘍並穿孔（A）、肢體皮膚潰瘍性結節與 PET/CT 鼻腔高攝取（B），以及血液/骨髓抹片中帶嗜天青顆粒的非典型大型淋巴球（C）。中線破壞性壞死病灶是辨認鼻型的關鍵。
features: Panel A: necrotic ulcer of the hard palate progressing to a midline palatal perforation
Panel B left: multiple violaceous ulcerated nodules on an extremity (cutaneous involvement)
Panel B right: PET/CT with FDG-avid soft tissue in the nasal cavity
Panel C left: peripheral blood with atypical medium-to-large lymphoid cells with moderate basophilic cytoplasm and azurophilic granules
Panel C right: aspirate smear with clusters of atypical lymphoid cells (arrow), in keeping with leukemic/disseminated disease
describe_en: This composite illustrates the clinical spectrum of extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma. Clinical photographs show a necrotic hard palate ulcer with midline perforation and ulcerated violaceous cutaneous nodules on an extremity, and PET/CT demonstrates FDG-avid disease in the nasal cavity. Smears show atypical medium-to-large lymphoid cells with basophilic cytoplasm and azurophilic granules in blood and aspirate, representing leukemic or disseminated disease such as aggressive NK-cell leukemia. The morphologic panels are low resolution and cannot establish lineage; diagnosis requires tissue showing angiocentric necrosis with cytoplasmic CD3, CD56, cytotoxic markers, and EBER positivity. Findings are consistent with nasal, extranasal (cutaneous), and disseminated/leukemic forms of NK/T-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: GPA also causes destructive midline sinonasal necrosis but shows necrotizing granulomatous vasculitis with PR3-ANCA and lacks EBER-positive atypical cytotoxic lymphoid cells.
Angioinvasive fungi produce black necrotic palatal eschars with broad hyphae on biopsy rather than an atypical CD56/EBER-positive lymphoid infiltrate.
It can produce similar ulcerated skin nodules but is TCR gamma-delta positive and EBER negative.
Aggressive NK-cell leukemia presents primarily with circulating granular NK cells, marrow involvement, and fulminant course without a dominant nasal mass, though it overlaps with disseminated ENKTL.
